positions.as_written: Protect the infrapatellar branch of the saphenous nerve by keeping the distal dissection where the branch is not, and warn the patient that numbness lateral to the scar is common whatever is done.
Treat loss of foot pulses after a distal femoral injury or a realignment as arterial until proven otherwise.
Expect bleeding when the lateral intermuscular septum is crossed, and control it before proceeding rather than after.
